Eligibility and academic Qualifications required for BE/BTech (Four Year) Degree programmes For admission to B.E./B.Tech Courses, candidates should have completed 12 years of schooling (equivalent to 10+2 system of Indian Education). The candidate should provide equivalent mark or mark range for grades from the Principal. You will be booked under malpractice but will be allowed to continue the examination. See malpractice guidelines on the examination website. title: PSG Tech Overview & Key Institutional Facts
content: PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech) is a premier government-aided, autonomous, private engineering institution established in 1951 in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded by PSG & Sons' Charities Trust under the visionary leadership of Sri G.R. Govindarajulu and Dr. G.R. Damodaran. Affiliation: Affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. Approved by AICTE, New Delhi. Accreditation: Accredited by NAAC with the prestigious 'A++' Grade. All engineering departments are accredited by NBA. Counselling Code: Anna University TNEA / TANCET Counselling Code is 2006. Campus Features: 45+ acre sprawling green campus, state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, Central Library, PSG-STEP (Science & Technology Entrepreneurial Park), sports grounds, student hostels, and industry-institute collaborative centers.

title: Admissions & Eligibility Guide (UG, PG, MCA, MBA)
content: Admission to PSG College of Technology is conducted through merit-based government quotas and management quotas: 1. B.E. / B.Tech Admissions: Through Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) single-window counseling conducted by the Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE) / Anna University. TNEA Counselling Code: 2006. Minimum eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. 2. Lateral Entry (2nd Year B.E./B.Tech): For Diploma and B.Sc graduates through Centralized Lateral Entry Counselling. 3. M.E. / M.Tech Admissions: Through TANCA counselling based on GATE / CEETA-PG scores. 4. MCA (Master of Computer Applications): 2-year full-time postgraduate degree. Eligibility: Passed BCA / B.Sc (Computer Science / IT) or undergraduate degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or Degree level with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category). Admission through TANCET conducted by Anna University. 5. MBA Admissions: Through TANCET / MAT / CAT scores via centralized counselling or management admission.

title: Hostels & Residential Facilities (Boys & Girls)
content: PSG Tech provides on-campus hostel accommodation for both male and female students: Boys Hostels: Located adjacent to the academic blocks with multiple blocks (Junior, Senior, PG blocks). Girls Hostels: Located securely within campus premises with biometric entry and round-the-clock security. Facilities: 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi internet, RO purified drinking water, hot water geysers, indoor sports room, gymnasium, reading rooms, TV hall, and laundry services. Mess: Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess facilities offering hygienic South Indian and North Indian food. Monthly mess bill is based on dividing system. Timings & Curfew: General hostel gates close at 8:30 PM on weekdays. Special late permission can be availed via parent/warden authorization for academic project works or laboratory sessions.

title: Placements & Career Guidance Highlights
content: PSG Tech boasts a legendary placement record with over 90% placement consistency year-on-year: Top Recruiters: Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Cisco, Qualcomm, DE Shaw, Texas Instruments, Oracle, SAP, Zoho, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Wipro, Caterpillar, L&T, Robert Bosch, Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, and Goldman Sachs. Salary Statistics: - Highest Domestic Package: Up to ₹52 LPA - ₹56 LPA. - Average Package: ₹11.5 LPA - ₹12.5 LPA across engineering streams. - Dream & Super Dream offers: Over 300+ students receive packages exceeding ₹15 LPA. Training & Placement Cell conducts aptitude tests, soft skills bootcamps, technical coding assessments, and mock interviews starting from 3rd year.

title: Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy
content: Under Autonomous Regulations of PSG College of Technology: Attendance Policy: Minimum required attendance is 75% in every course to be eligible to appear for the Autonomous End-Semester Examinations (ESE). Students having between 65% and 74% attendance due to documented medical reasons or authorized college representation may apply for condonation. Students below 65% attendance must repeat the course. Continuous Assessment (CA): Includes tests (CA1, CA2), assignments, tutorials, quizzes, and mini-projects contributing towards internal marks. Grading System: 10-point scale: O (Outstanding, 10), A+ (Excellent, 9), A (Very Good, 8), B+ (Good, 7), B (Above Average, 6), C (Average, 5), RA (Reappear, 0).

title: Campus Facilities, Central Library & Working Hours
content: PSG Tech Campus Resources: Dr. G.R. Damodaran Central Library: Holds over 2,50,000 volumes, 50,000+ e-journals (IEEE, ScienceDirect, Springer, ASME, ASCE), and digital learning facilities. Working hours: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on all working days. Health Center: 24x7 medical assistance with qualified resident medical officers, emergency ambulance service connected to PSG Hospitals, Peelamedu. Sports & Recreation: 400m athletic track, football ground, cricket nets, basketball courts with floodlights, tennis courts, and modern indoor badminton stadium. Transport: Extensive fleet of college buses operating across Coimbatore, Tirupur, Pollachi, and Mettupalayam routes.

title: Parents Guide: Ward Monitoring, Campus Safety & Healthcare
content: Essential Information for Parents at PSG College of Technology: 1. Academic Progress Tracking (Parent Zone): Parents can track their ward's day-to-day attendance, internal test marks (CA1, CA2), continuous assessment results, and semester exam grades by logging into the official Parent Portal (https://www.psgtech.edu/parentzone.php) using the student's Roll Number and Date of Birth. 2. Tutor-Ward Mentoring System: Every student is assigned a dedicated faculty advisor (Tutor) who closely monitors academic performance and emotional well-being. Tutors conduct monthly reviews and proactively contact parents if attendance falls below 75% or internal marks need improvement. 3. Medical & Hospital Support: On-campus health clinic with resident medical officers. Direct emergency connectivity and priority ambulance access to the renowned 1400-bed PSG Hospitals located just 500 meters from campus. 4. Campus Security & Curfew: Round-the-clock security guards, CCTV surveillance in all corridors and common zones, biometric access in hostels, and strict 8:30 PM gate closure for student safety. 5. Direct Contact: Parents can schedule meetings with Heads of Departments (HoDs), the Dean of Academic Affairs, or the Principal during working days (09:00 AM to 04:30 PM).

title: Tuition Fees, Scholarships & Financial Concessions
content: Fees and Financial Aid at PSG College of Technology: 1. Government Quota Fees: Moderate, regulated fees as determined by the Tamil Nadu Government Fee Fixation Committee for aided and self-financing engineering programmes. 2. State Government Scholarships: Full tuition fee concessions and maintenance allowances for SC/ST/SCA students; Post-Matric scholarships for BC/MBC/DNC students through the Directorate of Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare. 3. First Generation Graduate Concession: Tuition fee waiver of ₹25,000 to ₹27,500 per year as granted by the Tamil Nadu Government for eligible students whose parents are non-graduates. 4. Merit & Alumni Scholarships: PSG & Sons' Charities Trust provides need-cum-merit financial assistance to deserving economically disadvantaged students. PSG Tech Alumni Association (PSG Tech Alumni Trust) provides educational loans and interest-free grants. 5. Central Schemes: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for female engineering students, AICTE Saksham for differently-abled students, and Central Sector Scholarship for merit holders.

title: Specialized Programmes: 5-Year Sandwich Engineering & Integrated M.Sc
content: Flagship Unique Academic Offerings at PSG Tech: 1. 5-Year B.E. Sandwich Programmes (Mechanical, Production, Electrical & Electronics): - Unique to PSG College of Technology in India, established in collaboration with PSG Industrial Institute. - Structure: Students alternate between classroom academic study and real-time industrial training at machine shops, assembly units, and industrial manufacturing plants. - Outcome: Graduates possess 1.5 years of verifiable industrial work experience by the time of graduation, making them highest-priority recruits in core engineering giants (Caterpillar, L&T, Robert Bosch, Tata Motors). 2. 5-Year Integrated M.Sc Programmes: - Specialized branches: Software Systems, Data Science, Theoretical Computer Science, Cyber Security, Decision & Computing Sciences. - Eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics and Physics. Excellent alternative to traditional B.Tech with guaranteed full-semester corporate internships starting in the 7th and 9th semesters.

title: Campus Discipline, Anti-Ragging Policy & Student Welfare
content: Campus Discipline, Anti-Ragging & Student Support Ecosystem: 1. Anti-Ragging Strict Policy: PSG College of Technology strictly follows a Zero-Tolerance policy against ragging as per UGC / AICTE norms. Dedicated Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad conduct surprise inspections in academic buildings, hostels, and sports grounds. - National Anti-Ragging Helpline (Toll-Free): 1800-180-5522. 2. Women Welfare & Internal Complaints Committee (ICC): Chaired by senior women faculty to ensure a secure, respectful, and empowering environment for all female students, researchers, and staff. 3. Student Grievance Redressal Cell (SGRC): Provides a fair, confidential online and offline mechanism for addressing student concerns regarding examinations, academic evaluations, or campus amenities. 4. Career & Psychological Counselling: On-campus professional student counsellor available to assist students with stress management, academic focus, and career decision-making.
